prompt: Invert a map with unique values: build a TreeMap that maps each value back to its key.
explanation: Inverting a map means every (key, value) entry becomes (value, key) in the result, which only works cleanly when the values are unique -- otherwise later entries would overwrite earlier ones. entrySet() is the idiomatic way to visit key and value together in one pass. Collecting into a TreeMap sorts the new integer keys, giving deterministic iteration order.
hints: Loop over m.entrySet() so each iteration hands you both the key and the value.
For each entry, call result.put(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey()) -- value and key swap roles.
Create the result as new TreeMap<Integer, String>() before the loop and return it after.
